name: masthead
description: Give your book an AI editorial board: notes backed by quotes from your own text, a check for contradictions in age, date and place, simulated reader reactions, and a visual report showing where your book stands on The Wayfarer's Seven Stages. Publishify never receives your full text, and the board never changes it.

language.title: Report language
language.description: Leave empty to use the language of your conversation. To choose another, enter a code such as tr, en, de or fr.
